name: PostgreSQL 15.3 Database Engine
documentation: The PostgreSQL relational database management system (RDBMS), version 15.3, deployed as the engine of the AWS RDS instance for the payment system. It provides SQL query processing, transaction management, ACID compliance, and data persistence services to application workloads. It is hosted within the aws-rds-postgres-db Node and exposes a database technology service consumed by the EKS-hosted payment application.
